'''Drilleroo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Cragolin]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Convinced those claws can pierce through anything. If not, it's because Drilleroo was holding back."

Drilleroo is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Drilleroo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Cragolin]] you need to complete the following task:

* Feed Drilleroo Gem Taco x3.
